display_title: The Ex Who Came Back Into My Life
description:
The unforgettable “that” of her ex-boyfriend—was this really fate bringing them back together? 

He shows up again, on his own: Kang In-ho, the man who ghosted her and marked their relationship as her worst ever. Her mind tells her to push him away, but her body remembers him too well, pulling Han Aram back in. Too intense to be just about desire, yet too distant to call it a reunion.

Can they really meet again?
